contexts.text: In order to represent the state of the Church, Hosea the prophet was commanded...

As the Prophet Hosea, from the first chapter to the last, treats of the falsification of the Word, and of the destruction of the Church thereby; and as by whoredom is signified the falsification of truth therein, that prophet was commanded to take a harlot to wife, and to beget sons (chapter 1) and also to marry an adulterous woman (chapter 3) in order that he might represent that state of the Church.
